**STEP 1 - Scene:** A plated meal, probably a salad-and-roasted-vegetable plate. Roasted cauliflower, roasted vegetable pieces, and leafy greens sit on one side, with a creamy dressed salad on the other. The plate is about half to two-thirds used, with scattered crumbs.
